brew coffee.name: retrieve mug
brew coffee.definition: Open cupboard and take out a mug to place under the coffee machine

brew coffee.name: position mug
brew coffee.definition: Place the mug under the nozzle of the coffee machine

brew coffee.name: prepare machine
brew coffee.definition: Adjust machine parts and turn on the coffee machine

fill water tank.name: remove tank
fill water tank.definition: Lift the lid and remove the water tank from the coffee machine

fill water tank.name: pour water
fill water tank.definition: Fill the water tank using the water filter jug

fill water tank.name: replace tank
fill water tank.definition: Close the lid and place the water tank back onto the coffee machine

load coffee capsule.name: retrieve capsule
load coffee capsule.definition: Open the capsule box and take out a coffee capsule

load coffee capsule.name: insert capsule
load coffee capsule.definition: Open the machine compartment and slide the capsule inside

load coffee capsule.name: lock compartment
load coffee capsule.definition: Pull down the machine handle to lock the capsule in place

froth milk.name: retrieve milk
froth milk.definition: Open the fridge and take out the milk bottle

froth milk.name: pour milk
froth milk.definition: Open milk bottle and pour milk into the milk frother

froth milk.name: start frother
froth milk.definition: Plug in and turn on the milk frother to prepare frothed milk

assemble final drink.name: pour milk
assemble final drink.definition: Tilt the milk frother to pour frothed milk into the mug with coffee

assemble final drink.name: stir coffee
assemble final drink.definition: Take a wooden stirrer and mix the coffee and frothed milk together

clean equipment.name: rinse frother
clean equipment.definition: Take the milk frother to the tap, open water, and rinse it out

clean equipment.name: discard waste
clean equipment.definition: Open the trash bin and throw away used stirrers or expired items

clean equipment.name: dry hands
clean equipment.definition: Wipe and dry hands using a kitchen towel
